caption: The drawing is a technical illustration of a furniture piece labeled as "PLATE #1." It shows two black line drawings of a pier table with a marble top on an off-white or light beige background. The left side displays a side view of the table, with four cabriole legs that are ornately carved with scroll and leaf patterns; the skirt just beneath the table top features a repeating openwork design with floral and leaf motifs. The top of the table is rectangular and the apron below the top is curved. The right side of the drawing presents a front view of the same table, highlighting the same decorative elements, with two of the carved legs clearly visible. Dimensions are indicated: 52 inches wide, 27 inches deep, and 33 inches high, with further measured details such as 50 3/16 inches for the length of the tabletop and 25 7/8 inches for its depth. The title block in the lower right gives additional information: "Pier Table, Mah. (Marble Top), Phila., 1760-1775," and a museum reference number along with the name John Dieterich. There are also notes referencing "Plate #2" for more comprehensive details of carving, and all lines and text are rendered in black ink.
title: Pier Table
